title: Finite generation of the graded section module
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $S=k[x_0,x_1]$ with its standard grading, and $P=\operatorname{Proj}S$ as in [def-sc-p1-standard]. Let $\mathcal G$ be a coherent [pqf-def-coherent] $\mathcal O_P$-module and write $\mathcal G(n)=\mathcal G\otimes\mathcal O_P(n)$ for the standard twists [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf]. The truncated graded $S$-module $M_{\ge 0}=\bigoplus_{n\ge 0}\Gamma(P,\mathcal G(n))$, with the action induced by multiplication by homogeneous polynomials in $S$, is finitely generated.

proof.text: Apply [lem-pc-projective-space-twist-quotient] with $A=k$ and $n=1$. It supplies integers $m_j\ge0$ and an exact sequence $0\to\mathcal K\to\mathcal E:=\bigoplus_{j=1}^r\mathcal O_P(-m_j)\to\mathcal G\to0$, with $\mathcal K$ coherent. The field $k$ is Noetherian and $P$ is the projective line of [def-sc-p1-standard]. The twists of the statement agree with the twisting modules used here: by [lem-sc-p1-proj-shifted-free-twist], $\widetilde{S(d)}$ of [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf] is isomorphic to the twisting module $\mathcal O_P(d)$ of [def-sc-p1-standard] and [lem-sc-p1-twist-exists]; and the module $\mathcal O_P(d)$ of [def-pc-projective-space-twist] with $A=k$, $n=1$ has bases $e_0^{(d)},e_1^{(d)}$ on $U_0,U_1$ with $e_0^{(d)}=(x_0/x_1)^de_1^{(d)}=t^{-d}e_1^{(d)}$ on $U_{01}$, so it is a twisted structure sheaf in the sense of [def-sc-p1-standard] and is the same module by the uniqueness in [lem-sc-p1-twist-exists].

source.place: Stacks Project, Lemma 01YS (coherent-lemma-coherent-on-Pn), proof of (5), first paragraph

proof.text: The twists $\mathcal O_P(d)$ are invertible by [lem-sc-p1-twist-exists]. Thus tensoring the sequence of Step 1 with $\mathcal O_P(d)$ stays exact by [lem-sc-ext-tensor-exact]. The long exact cohomology sequence of [pqf-def-cohomology] contains $H^0(P,\mathcal E(d))\to H^0(P,\mathcal G(d))\to H^1(P,\mathcal K(d))$. Apply [lem-pc-projective-space-serre-vanishing] to the coherent $\mathcal K$: there is $N\ge0$ such that the last term is zero for every $d\ge N$. Hence the first map is surjective for every such $d$, and these maps form a surjection of graded $S$-modules $\bigoplus_{d\ge N}H^0(P,\mathcal E(d))\twoheadrightarrow M_{\ge N}$, since the maps in Step 1 commute with multiplication by homogeneous elements of $S$.

source.place: Stacks Project, Lemma 01YS (coherent-lemma-coherent-on-Pn), proof of (5), first paragraph

proof.text: By [lem-pc-twist-tensor], $\mathcal O_P(-m_j)\otimes\mathcal O_P(d)\cong\mathcal O_P(d-m_j)$, so $H^0(P,\mathcal E(d))=\bigoplus_jH^0(P,\mathcal O_P(d-m_j))$, as $H^0$ commutes with finite direct sums. By [lem-pc-projective-space-twist-cohomology] (i), $H^0(P,\mathcal O_P(d-m_j))$ is the degree-$(d-m_j)$ part of $S$, zero when $d<m_j$. The monomial identification respects multiplication by $x_0,x_1$, so $\bigoplus_{d\ge0}H^0(P,\mathcal E(d))\cong\bigoplus_j S(-m_j)$ as graded $S$-modules; the right side has the finite homogeneous basis given by the $r$ summands. Its graded submodule $\bigoplus_{d\ge N}H^0(P,\mathcal E(d))$ is finitely generated by [lem-sc-p1-graded-submodule-finite]. Its quotient $M_{\ge N}$ is therefore finitely generated by Step 2.

source.place: Stacks Project, Lemma 01YS (coherent-lemma-coherent-on-Pn), proof of (5), second and third paragraphs

proof.text: For each of the finitely many degrees $0\le d<N$, the twist $\mathcal G(d)$ is coherent: locally the invertible $\mathcal O_P(d)$ is free of rank one, so the twist is locally isomorphic to $\mathcal G$. By [lem-sc-p1-coherent-finite], each $H^0(P,\mathcal G(d))$ is a finite-dimensional $k$-vector space. Choose a finite basis in each such degree and homogeneous generators of $M_{\ge N}$ from Step 3. Together they generate $M_{\ge0}$ as an $S$-module: the high-degree elements lie in $M_{\ge N}$, and every low-degree element is a $k$-linear combination of the chosen basis, with $k=S_0$. This includes $N=0$, when there are no low degrees.

split_report.summary: Specialized the proof of Stacks 01YS(5): a finite twist quotient gives a surjection on high-degree sections after Serre vanishing; sections of the twists form finite graded free modules, their high-degree submodules are finite, and the finitely many lower graded pieces are finite-dimensional. Stacks 0AG6(4) gives the exact item statement. No new node was needed.
split_report.blueprint: Realizes the first sentence of the proof of lem-sc-p1-graded-resolution: the coherent module G is represented by a finitely generated graded module over k[x_0,x_1].

tool_uses.why: Its finite twist quotient and coherent kernel are the input to the high-degree section argument.
Its H^1 vanishing for high twists of the coherent kernel makes the sections map surjective.
Its H^0 calculation identifies the sections of each twist with a homogeneous piece of S.
Its invertibility assertion supplies exact twisting and local triviality.
Its H^0 finiteness supplies generators in the finitely many lower degrees.
Its canonical isomorphism O(d) tensor O(e) = O(d+e) identifies the twists of the summands of the twist quotient. (Added by reviewer R-ssm2.)
